sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Wait a sec — the batch was supposed to be UP×4 + LEFT×4, but the executed actions show "UP, UP, UP, UP, LEFT, LEFT, LEFT" — only 3 LEFTs! And the white center is at (9,18), not (9,15). Hmm, the action list shows 7 actions: UP×4, LEFT×3. Did the 4th LEFT get dropped? Or… the result shows the center at (9,18). So only 3 LEFTs were executed. Strange — maybe the environment dropped one action, or the batch got truncated. Oh well — one more LEFT is needed.
More importantly: looking at the image and data:
- Row 9, columns 3-27: "BBcYYYYYYYYYYYYWYYYYYYYY" → (9,5)=c, (9,6)=Y?? Wait: columns 3-27: index 3='B',4='B',5='c',6='Y',7='Y',... So (9,5)=c, (9,6)=Y, (9,7..17)=Y (arm), (9,18)=W (center), (9,19..26)=Y (arm).
- The dot at (9,6): the ring node 4 is now c 7 pixels: [[8,5],[8,7],[8,6],[9,5],[10,6],[10,7],[10,5]] — 7 pixels: (8,5),(8,6),(8,7),(9,5),(10,5),(10,6),(10,7). The core (9,6) is now Y — but the arm is passing through row 9! The arm covers (9,6). So the core is hidden under the arm. The ring lost (9,6)?? No wait — the ring's pixels: originally 8: (8,5),(8,6),(8,7),(9,5),(9,7),(10,5),(10,6),(10,7). Now 7: (8,5),(8,6),(8,7),(9,5),(10,5),(10,6),(10,7). Missing: (9,7)! That's now under the arm (row 9, column 7 — the arm covers columns 7..29). So (9,7) is hidden under the arm. The ring is intact, just occluded.
- The dot at (9,24): ring node 5: c 3 [[8,23],[8,25]] — only the top row (8,23),(8,24),(8,25)?? And node 10: c 3 [[10,23],[10,25]] — the bottom row. The middle row (9,23),(9,25) is hidden under the arm (row 9, columns 7..29 covers 23,25). The core (9,24) is also hidden.
- Column 15, rows 1-19: "BcYcBBBBYBBBBBBcYc" → row 1='B',2='c',3='Y',4='c',5..8='B',9='Y',10..14='B',15='c',16='Y',17='c',18='B'... So the dots at (3,15) and (17,15) are intact, and the vertical arm at column 15 covers rows -2..20 → (9,15)=Y (arm).
So currently: the yellow cross's center is at (9,18). The dots at (9,6) and (9,24) are on the horizontal arm (row 9) — but the center is at column 18, not column 15. The dots at (3,15),(17,15) are on column 15 — not on the vertical arm (the vertical arm is at column 18, rows -2..20; (3,15) is column 15, not 18). So currently, 2 dots are on the arms.
No visible reaction yet (the dots are intact, the score is 0). The purple bar is now 35 (it was 52 before the batch). It's shrinking fast — about 17 units in 7 actions + thinking time. It's a real-time timer. Need to hurry!
One more LEFT → center (9,15): all 4 yellow dots will be on the arms. Then observe the reaction.
Let's execute LEFT and inspect.
